m: सम्-√ इ P. -एति, to go or come together, meet at (acc.) or with (instr. or dat.), encounter (as friends or enemies), RV. &c. &c.; to come together in sexual union, cohabit (acc. or सार्धम्, सह), MBh.; R.; to come to, arrive at, approach, visit, seek, enter upon, begin, RV. &c. &c.; to lead to (acc.), RV. iii, 54, 5; to consent, agree with (instr. ‘it is agreed between’, with gen. of pers. and loc. of thing), ŚBr.; MBh. : Pass. -ईयते, to be united or met or resorted to &c.: Intens. -ईयते, to visit, frequent, RV.; to appear, be manifested, BhP.
a: समि — {c2c} P. 1 To come or meet together, be united or joined with. --2 To go or come to, arrive at, approach, reach, visit, attain. --3 To encounter, meet in a hostile manner. --4 To cohabit, have sexual intercourse. --5 To enter upon, commence. --6 To agree with.

v: strA saminData'nayA sam + inDa--karaRe kvip । 1 kAzWe 2 homIyakAzWaBede ca tallakzaRaM Candoga॰ “nANguzWAdaDikA nonA samit sTUlatayA kvacit । na nirmuktatvacA cEva na makIwA na pAwitA । prAdeSAnnADikA nonA na taTA syAdviSAKikA । na sapatrA na nirvIryyA hemezu ca vijAnatA” iti । tasya nizidDalakzaRaM yaTA “viSIRAM vidalA hrasvA vakrAH sTUlA dviDAkftAH । kfmidazwASca dIrGASca samiDo nEva kArayet” tatra domo yaTA “viSIrRAyuHkzayaM kuryyAdvidalA putranASinI । hrasvA nASayate patnIM vakrA banDuvinASinI kfmidazwA rogakarI vidvezakaraRI dviDA । paSUn mArayate dIrGA sTUlA cArTavinASanI” tantrasA॰ ।
m: समिध् mfn. igniting, flaming, burning, RV.
समिध् f. firewood, fuel, a log of wood, faggot, grass &c. employed as fuel (7 Samidhs, or sometimes 3 × 7 are mentioned, as well as 7 Yonis, 7 flames &c.), RV. &c. &c.
kindling, flaming, RV.; VS.; ŚBr.
= समिद्-आधान, ŚrS.
a: समिध् — f. Wood, fuel; especially fuel or sacrificial sticks for the sacred fire; समिदाहरणाय Ś. 1; Ku. 1. 57; 5. 33.

m: सम्˚इधा sa/mf. an oblation to fuel or firewood, Gṛhyās.

s: puM, (samiDyate iti । saM + inDa + kaH .) agniH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 2 । 24 । 6 । “ayantu mAmAtmaBavastavAdarSanamArutaH । vilApaduHKasamiDo ruditASruhutAhutiH ॥”)
v: pu॰ samiDyate sam + inDa--ka । 1 kAzWe 2 bahnO ca trikA॰ ।
m: सम्˚इध (ifc.) = समिध्, fuel, wood, R.
सम्˚इध m. fire, L.
समिधम् See above under verb.
सम्˚इधे See above under verb.
सम्-इध्य Nom. P. ˚यति (fut. -इध्यिता or -इधिता), to wish for fuel, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 50, Sch.
सम्-इध्यमान mfn. (pr. p. Pass.) being kindled or ignited
सम्-इध्यमान—वत् mfn. containing the word समिध्यमान, KātyŚr.

a: समिंध् — {c7c} A. 1 To kindle, light up, ignite. --2 To excite, inflame, kindle (anger &c.). --3 To glorify. --Pass. To catch or take fire.

m: सम्-√ इङ्ग् Caus. -इङ्गयति, to cause to move or throb, agitate, shake about, RV.
स-मिश्र mfn. mixing, mingling, undergoing mixture or combination (in अ-सम्˚), BhP.

s: puM, (sametIti । sam + iR + “samIRaH .” uRA॰ 2 । 11 । iti Tak .) agniH । ityuRAdikozaH ॥ yudDam । iti sidDAntakOmudyAmuRAdivfttiH ॥ (yaTA, fgvede । 4 । 20 । 8 । “SikzAnaraH samiTezu prahAvAn vasvo rASimaBinetAsi BUrim ॥” asminnarTe kvacit klIve'pi dfSyate । yaTA, tatrEva । 1 । 55 । 5 । “sa inmahAni samiTAni majjanA kfRoti yuDma ojasA janeByaH ॥”) AhutiH । iti saMkziptasAroRAdivfttiH ॥
v: pu॰ sama + iRa--Tak । 1 vahnO 2 yudDe ca si॰ kO॰ । 3 AhutO sakziptasA॰ ।
m: सम्-इथ m. hostile encounter, conflict, collision, RV.
fire, L.
offering, oblation, ib.
a: समिथः — 1 War, battle. --2 Fire. --3 An offering, oblation.

m: स-मिथुन mf(आ)n. together with the pair or couple (or ‘with the mate’), ŚBr.

s: [D] strI, (samiDyate'nayeti । saM + inDa + kvip .) samit । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 2 । 176 । “nityaH snAtvA SuciH kuryyAt devarzipitftarpaRam । devatAByarccanaYcEva samidADAnameva ca ॥”)
m: समिद् in comp. for समिध्.
समिद्—आधान n. the placing on of wood or fuel (for the oblation to fire), Mn. ii, 176.
समिद्—आहरण n. fetching fuel, Śak.
समिद्धाग्नि mfn. one who has kindled his fire, RV.
समिद्धार्थक m. N. of a man, Mudr.
समिद्—धार (for -हार), mfn. fetching f˚ (nom. with √ गम्, ‘to go to fetch f˚’), Āpast.
समिद्धार्चिस् n. a blazing flame, MW.
समिद्धारिन् mfn. carrying a load of fuel, Baudh.

s: puM, (saM + inDa + ktaH .) pradIptaH । yaTA, kAtyAyanaH । “yo'narccizi juhotyagnO vyaNgAriRi ca mAnavaH । mandAgnirAmayAvI ca daridraSca sa jAyate । tasmAt samidDe hotavyaM nAsamidDe kadAcana ॥” iti saMskAratattvam ॥
m: 1. सम्-इद्ध mfn. (for 2. See col. 3), Prākṛt for सम्-ऋद्ध, perfect, full, complete, HirGṛ.
2. सम्-इद्ध mfn. (for 1. See col. 2) set alight or on fire, lighted, kindled, ignited, inflamed, RV.; &c.
a: समिद्ध — p. p. 1 Lighted up, kindled. --2 Set on fire. --3 Inflamed, excited.

m: सम्-इद्ध—शरण mfn. having (its) habitations set on fire (as a town), MW.
सम्-इद्ध—दर्प mfn. inflamed with pride, MW.
सम्-इद्ध—होम m. a libation poured out upon lighted wood, ŚBr.
सम्-इद्ध—वत् mfn. containing the word समिद्ध, KātyŚr.
समिद्—धोम (for -होम), m. an oblation of f˚ (to fire), MW.
समिद्—अन्त mfn. ending with the word समिध्, KātyŚr.
समिद्—दृषद n. f˚. and a stone, Pāṇ. v, 4, 106, Sch.
समिद्—इध्म-व्रश्चन n. splitting fire wood of various kinds, Mcar.
समिद्—वत् (समिद्-), mfn. provided with f˚, Śak.
containing the word समिध् (समिद्-वती f. a verse containing the word समिध्), TS.; Vait.
a: समिद्वत् — a. Fed or supplied with fuel; समिद्वंतः प्रांतसंस्तीर्णदर्भाः (वह्नयः) Ś. 4. 7.

s: klI, Selam । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ va~qsA iti BAzA ॥
v: na॰ sam--iRa--qi saMjYAyAM kan । SelAstre (vaqaSA) Sabdara॰ ।
m: 1. समिक (fr. समा; for 2. See s.v.) See द्वै-स्˚.
2. समिक n. (for 1 See p. 1153, col. 2) a pike, javelin, dart, L.
समिन् m. N. of a son of Rājādhideva (v.l. शमिन्), Hariv.

सम्-√ इन्ध् Ā. -इन्द्धे, or -इन्धे (once in Br. 3. pl. impf. -ऐन्धन्; cf. Nir. x, 8; Ved. inf. -इधम् and -इधे), to set fire to, set alight, light up, kindle, ignite, inflame (lit. and fig.), RV.; AV.; Br.; Mn.; to take fire, RV. vii, 8, 1; to swell, increase, exhibit, show, betray. (skill), Bhaṭṭ. : Pass. -इध्यते, to be kindled, take fire, break out into flame, RV.; &c.

s: klI, (samiDyate'neneti । saM + inDa + lyuw .) samit । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, BawwiH । 2 । 28 । “tapomarudBirBavatAM SarAgniH saMDukzyatAM no'risaminDaneyu ॥”)
v: pu॰ sam + inDa--karaRe lyuw । 1 kAzWe Sabdaca॰ । BAve lyuw । 2 samyagdIptO ca ।
m: सम्-इन्धन m. N. of a man, Cat.
सम्-इन्धन n. the act of kindling, Nir.
fuel, firewood, Bhaṭṭ.
a means of swelling or increasing of (gen.), MBh. xii, 4385.
सम्-इनक्ष् (see इनक्ष्), -इनक्षति, to wish to attain, strive to reach, be desirous of RV.
सम्-√ इन्व् P. -इन्वति, to impart, bestow, RV.; to put together, restore, ib.
सम्-इर m. = सम्-ईर, wind, air (see सम्-√ ईर्), L.
N. of Śiva, L.

[D] strI, (samIDyate'nayeti । inDa + kvip .) agnisandIpanArTatfRakAzWAdiH । tatparyyAyaH । inDanam 2 eDam 3 iDmam 4 eDaH 5 । ityamaraH ॥ saminDanam 6 । etasmin sUkzme kiliYjam । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ * ॥ homIyasamillakzaRaM matsyapurARe । “prAdeSamAtrAH saSiKAH savalkASca palAsinIH । samiDaH kalpayet prAjYaH sarvvakarmmasu sarvvadA ॥” lakzaRAntaraM yaTA, CandogapariSizwam । “nANguzWAdaDikA nyUnA samit sTUlatayA kvacit । na nirmmuktatvacA cEva na sakIwA na pAwitA ॥ prAdeSAt nADikA nonA na taTA syAdviSAKikA । na sapatrA na nirvIryyA homezu ca vijAnatA ॥” iti saMskAratattvam ॥ * ॥ tasya nizidDalakzaRaM yaTA, -- “viSIrRA vidalA hrasvA vakrAH sTUlA dviDAkftAH । kfmidazwASca dIrGASca samiDo nEva kArayet ॥” atra dozo yaTA, -- “viSIrRayuHkzayaM kuryyAdbidalA puttranASinI । hsvA nASayate patnIM vakrA banDuvinASinI ॥ kfmidzwA rogakarI vidvezakaraRI dviDA । paSUn mArayate dIrGA sTUlA cArTavinASinI ॥” iti tantram ॥ * ॥ navagrahARAM samiDo yaTA, -- “arkaH palASaH KadirastvapAmArgo'Ta pippalaH । uqumbaraH SamI dUrvvAH kuSASca samiDaH kramAt ॥” iti saMskAratattve yAjYavalkyavacanam ॥

समित् in comp. for समिध् (for सम्-इत् See above).
a: समित् — f. War, battle; समिति पतिनिपाताकर्णन &c. N. 12. 75.

k.v: काष्ठं दार्विन्धनं त्वेध इध्ममेधः समित्स्त्रियाम्. निष्कुहः कोटरं वा ना वल्लरिर्मञ्जरिः स्त्रियौ॥
समुदायः स्त्रियः संयत्समित्याजिसमिद्युधः। नियुद्धं बाहुयुद्धेऽथ तुमुलं रणसङ्कुले॥

m: स-मिता (आ), f. wheat-flour, Bhpr.; Divyāv.
सम्-इत mfn. (for स-मित See below) come together, assembled, joined or united or combined with (instr. or comp.), RV.; MBh.
promised, agreed, assented to, MW.
finished, completed, ib.
स-मित mfn. (fr. 7. स + 2. मित) measured, meted out (opp. to अ-मित), Kpr.
(= सम्-मित) commensurate, equal to (comp.), MBh.; Suśr.
a: समित — p. p. 1 Come together, met. --2 Collected, assembled. --3 Connected, united with. --4 Contiguous. --5 Parallel. --6 Promised, agreed to. --7 Completed, finished.

m: स-मितम् (अम्) ind. continually, always, Kāraṇḍ.
समितृ w.r. for शमितृ, q.v.

m: 1. सम्-इति f. (for 2. See below) coming together, meeting, assembling, an assembly, council, RV.; AV.; MBh.; BhP.
a flock, herd, Kir.
association, society (personified as daughter of Prajā-pati), BhP.
a league, plot, RV.; AV.
encounter, hostile meeting, war, battle, Br.; MBh.; R.
sameness, likeness (cf. 2. सम), L.
(with Jainas) rule of life or conduct (five are enumerated, viz. ईर्या-, भाषा-, एषणा-, आदान-, and उत्सर्ग-स्˚), Sarvad.
2. सम्-इति ind. (for 1. See above) a sacred verse beginning with सम्, MW.
a: समितिः — f. 1 Meeting, union, association. --2 An assembly. --3 Flock, herd; Ki. 4. 32. --4 War, battle; Ś. 2. 15; Ki. 3. 15; Śi. 16. 13. --5 Likeness, equality. --6 Moderation.

k.v: समज्या परिषद्गोष्ठी सभासमितिसंसदः। आस्थानी क्लीबमास्थानं स्त्रीनपुंसकयोः सदः॥
समुदायः स्त्रियः संयत्समित्याजिसमिद्युधः। नियुद्धं बाहुयुद्धेऽथ तुमुलं रणसङ्कुले॥
नदी नगर्योर्नागानां भोगवत्यथ सङ्गरे। सङ्गे सभायां समितिः क्षयवासावपि क्षिती॥
नदी नगर्योर्नागानां भोगवत्यथ सङ्गरे। सङ्गे सभायां समितिः क्षयवासावपि क्षिती॥

सम्-इति—ं-जय (˚तिं-), mfn. ‘victorious in battle’ or ‘eminent in an assembly’ (also N. of Yama and Viṣṇu), MBh.; Hariv.; BhP.
सम्-इति—ंजय m. N. of a warrior, MBh.
सम्-इति—शालिन् mfn. warlike, brave, BhP.
सम्-इति—शोभन mfn. conspicuous in fight or battle, MBh.; R.
सम्-इति—मर्दन mfn. crushing or harassing in battle, ib.

समित्—कलाप m. a bundle of firewood, IndSt.
समित्—कुश n. fuel and Kuśa grass, Ragh.
समित्—पाणि (समित्-), mfn. holding fuel in the hands, ŚBr.

समित्—पान्थ m. fire, Gal.
समित्—पूल m. a bundle of firewood, MānGṛ.
स-मित्र mfn. attended by a friend, along with friends, MBh.
सम्-इत्—सज्ज mfn. ready for war or battle, Rājat.

समित्—समारोपण-विधान n. N. of wk.

सम्-इष्टि f. a complete sacrifice or oblation, TS.; TBr.
